description: This file defines the AssetRepository class, which implements CRUD and query operations for assets and related entities in a Postgres database. It includes nested classes for exceptions and various data transfer objects, as well as methods for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and validating assets and their associated resources. The code heavily interacts with a PostgreSQL database via Npgsql and adheres to a domain model aligned with a data asset management system.

classes.name: AssetRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing CRUD and query operations for assets and their related entities.

classes.name: EntityNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom exception thrown when a requested entity is not found during repository operations.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new asset record in the database based on provided request data.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves an asset by its ID, excluding soft-deleted entries.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing asset record based on provided data.

methods.name: QueryAsync
methods.description: Queries assets with optional filters and returns matching list.

methods.name: PermitEuIdExistsAsync
methods.description: Checks if a Permit EU ID exists among non-deleted assets, with optional exclusion for updates.

methods.name: AssetExistsAsync
methods.description: Checks if an asset exists and is not soft-deleted.

methods.name: SoftDeleteAssetGraphAsync
methods.description: Performs a soft delete of an asset and all related dependent records.

methods.name: InputParameterBelongsToAssetAsync
methods.description: Validates if a given input parameter belongs to specified asset.

methods.name: ThroughputEquationBelongsToInputAsync
methods.description: Checks if a throughput equation belongs to a specified input parameter.

methods.name: WouldParentInputMappingCreateCycleAsync
methods.description: Detects potential cycles in parent-child input parameter mappings to maintain hierarchy integrity.

methods.name: ReportingAttributeCombinationExistsAsync
methods.description: Verifies if a reporting attribute combination already exists for an asset.

methods.name: GetLatestStatusToDateAsync
methods.description: Fetches the most recent status_to_date for an asset, excluding soft-deleted rows.

methods.name: CreateAssetStatusLogAsync
methods.description: Creates a new status log entry for an asset.

methods.name: ListAssetStatusLogsAsync
methods.description: Lists all status logs for a given asset.

methods.name: GetAssetStatusLogByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific asset status log by its ID, ensuring it belongs to the asset.

methods.name: UpdateAssetStatusLogAsync
methods.description: Updates a specific status log entry under an asset.

methods.name: CreateAdditionalAssetIdAsync
methods.description: Creates an additional asset ID linked to an asset.

methods.name: ListAdditionalAssetIdsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all additional IDs for an asset.

methods.name: GetAdditionalAssetIdByIdAsync
methods.description: Gets a specific additional asset ID for an asset.

methods.name: UpdateAdditionalAssetIdAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing additional asset ID.

methods.name: CreateAssetPropertyAsync
methods.description: Creates a new asset property record.

methods.name: ListAssetPropertiesAsync
methods.description: Lists all properties for an asset.

methods.name: GetAssetPropertyByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific asset property.

methods.name: UpdateAssetPropertyAsync
methods.description: Updates an asset property record.

methods.name: CreateControlDeviceMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates a control device mapping under an asset.

methods.name: ListControlDeviceMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists control device mappings for an asset.

methods.name: GetControlDeviceMappingByIdAsync
methods.description: Gets a specific control device mapping.

methods.name: UpdateControlDeviceMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates a control device mapping.

methods.name: CreateInputParameterAsync
methods.description: Creates an input parameter under an asset.

methods.name: CreateInputParameterAsync
methods.description: Creates a new input parameter under an asset.

methods.name: ListInputParametersAsync
methods.description: Lists input parameters under an asset (excluding soft-deleted rows).

methods.name: GetInputParameterByIdAsync
methods.description: Gets an input parameter under an asset scope (returns null if not found).

methods.name: UpdateInputParameterAsync
methods.description: Updates an input parameter under an asset scope (returns null if not found).

methods.name: CreateParentInputMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates a parent input mapping for a child input parameter.

methods.name: ListParentInputMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists parent input mappings for a child input parameter.

methods.name: UpdateParentInputMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates a parent input mapping under a child input parameter scope.

methods.name: CreateReportingAttributeMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates a reporting attribute mapping under an asset.

methods.name: ListReportingAttributeMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists reporting attribute mappings for an asset.

methods.name: GetReportingAttributeMappingByIdAsync
methods.description: Gets a reporting attribute mapping under an asset.

methods.name: UpdateReportingAttributeMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates a reporting attribute mapping under an asset.

methods.name: CreateEfSourceMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates an EF source mapping under an input parameter.

methods.name: ListEfSourceMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists EF source mappings under an input parameter.

methods.name: UpdateEfSourceMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates an EF source mapping under an input parameter scope.

methods.name: ListThroughputEquationsAsync
methods.description: Lists throughput equations under an input parameter.

methods.name: UpdateThroughputEquationAsync
methods.description: Updates a throughput equation under an input parameter scope.

methods.description: Lists throughput scalars under a throughput equation.

methods.name: UpdateThroughputScalarAsync
